hero.name: Hudayfa
hero.title: a freelance web developer specialised in Shopify
hero.desc: I migrate, rebuild and debug e-commerce stores. Since November 2025 I have been working with brands on Shopify: WooCommerce migrations, theme rebuilds and performance optimisation.
hero.imageAlt: Hudayfa Koujdal, freelance Shopify developer, working at his computer

steps.label: What I do
steps.text: I work with e-commerce brands on Shopify: migrations from WooCommerce without losing existing search rankings, theme development and rebuilds in Liquid, plus one-off fixes and improvements. Six stores delivered since November 2025.

steps.label: My background
steps.text: I graduated in 2025 with a professional Bachelor's degree in 'IT Professions – Web Applications' from the University of Limoges, and completed it with three in-company experiences: WordPress at Synergie Media (2023), Shopify and Liquid at Zakaria Outahar (2024), then Vue.js and Strapi at monFeed (2025).

steps.label: How I work
steps.text: A written scope, deadline and price up front, a staging environment to validate before going live, and measurable results rather than promises: on amadal.ma the homepage renders in under a second, with 286 KB transferred and no layout shift (CLS of 0).

items.title: Mudaparis — WooCommerce → Shopify migration
items.desc: Freelance project (November 2025) for Mudaparis, a brand of traditional Moroccan menswear. Full migration of the store from WooCommerce to Shopify: products, collections and customer reviews were transferred, then the Horizon theme was customised to match the brand's identity.

items.title: Amadal.ma — rebuild & headless WordPress
items.desc: Freelance project (April 2026) for Amadal Global Systems, an irrigation solutions company. Rebuild of the site with a headless WordPress back-office, back-end work and SEO and performance optimisation. The site now loads in under a second, with around 286 KB transferred and no layout shift (CLS of 0).

items.title: Sàntibé — cart redesign
items.desc: Freelance project (April 2026) for Sàntibé Bijoux. Complete redesign of the cart drawer (side mini-cart) of the Horizon theme: smoother checkout journey, quantity updates and visual consistency with the rest of the store.

items.title: Soliferme — landing page rebuild
items.desc: Freelance project (December 2025) for Soliferme. Rebuild of the Shopify store's landing page: new section structure, responsive integration and customisation of the Horizon theme to showcase the offer.

items.title: Shopify maintenance & enhancements
items.desc: Recurring theme customisation work on Shopify Horizon for Soraali (June 2026) and LXIR (2026, a hydration tablet brand): building and editing snippets, sections and buttons, theme debugging and ad-hoc fixes based on each brand's needs.

items.title: MonFeed
items.desc: Project developed during my final-year internship at monFeed (formerly TheWebCake). MonFeed is an AI-powered platform that enables users to create, schedule, and publish content across social media. It features a dashboard, content editor, calendar, and AI-based analytics.

items.title: Flag
items.desc: Flag is an exciting group project developed in the second year of our degree. The game challenges your knowledge of world flags by displaying a random flag from any country. Your goal is to guess which country it belongs to. The more correct answers you give, the longer your winning streak grows.

items.title: Gourmet_Atlas
items.desc: Gourmet_Atlas is a group project created during the second year of our degree. It allows users to explore cuisines from around the world using the World Food Guide API. The app provides detailed information on each cuisine, lets users discover dishes with ingredients and preparation steps, and includes a photo gallery to visualize culinary specialties.
